title: AccessRoleChangedPayload
description: Payload of `access.role.changed` version 1: a role was defined, changed or deleted. Read the role with the API for its name and permissions. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner that owns the role, or `null` for a platform role. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

change.description: What happened: `defined`, `updated` (renamed or new permissions) or `deleted`. Consumers must tolerate values they do not know.
